fields.description: The day this activity happens. A plain date rather than a datetime because an itinerary is planned in days and hours, not to the second, and the time is its own field so a society can leave it blank for a whole-day activity.
fields.label: Date

fields.description: When on that day. Optional: an activity with no time is a whole-day one, which is an ordinary answer rather than a missing one.
fields.label: Time

fields.description: What happens: travel to the branch, community entry meeting, household visits, debrief. Never read by code.
fields.label: Activity

fields.description: Who leads this activity. Free text rather than a Link, because an itinerary is written before anybody is deployed and often names somebody outside the society altogether: a county officer, a partner agency's focal point, a community elder. The deployment's own leader is a separate answer, recorded on VMMS Deployment Assignment.
fields.label: Person Responsible
